subject: Post-call: Draft MAP — data handling milestones & next steps
messages:
From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: emma.foster@healthlytics.com, jared.cole@healthlytics.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Draft MAP — data handling milestones & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the clarity on your PHI scope and where Healthlytics wants the line drawn between ingestion and downstream analytics. Per our discussion, I attached a working MAP draft that isolates the data handling milestones we flagged. High-level recap and proposed owners below.

Summary (actionable items)
- Milestone A — Ingestion & minimization: define fields considered PHI/PII and mask at ingestion (Owner: Healthlytics legal + Data Ops)
- Milestone B — Retention & tiering: agree retention windows for raw logs, metrics, and model cache (Owner: Healthlytics product; Redwood to propose config)
- Milestone C — Audit & logging: enable per-request audit trails and redaction logs for PHI access (Owner: Redwood infra + Healthlytics security)
- Milestone D — SOC2 evidence & onboarding: deliver SOC2 report + access to audit logs for your auditors (Owner: Redwood compliance)

Dependencies / open questions (from our call)
- Exact list of PHI fields you want blocked vs. tokenized (Healthlytics to share sample schema)
- Desired retention window for raw user input (suggested: 30 days for raw, 365 days for hashed/aggregate logs)
- Whether you require immutable WORM-style retention or standard deletion policy (Legal Ops)

Next steps (requested by end of week)
1) Healthlytics: share sample schema + legal preference on retention (Emma/Jared)
2) Redwood: update MAP with explicit configs and a proposed target close date
3) Schedule a 30-min tech deep-dive for logging/keystore options (Laura to lead)

Attachments: MAP_Draft_Healthlytics_v0.9.pdf (working draft), SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf (for your review)

Proposed target: close MAP and sign SOW by 2026-12-10. If that target works, we'll lock milestone dates in the MAP doc and open the procurement track.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0178

--

From: Emma Foster <emma.foster@healthlytics.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: jared.cole@healthlytics.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP — data handling milestones & next steps

Thanks Alex — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our side after reviewing the draft:

1) PHI definition: we'll send the schema but to be explicit — protected health identifiers include full DOB, SSN, patient ID, and free-text clinical notes. We prefer masking patient ID at ingestion and full redaction of SSNs.

2) Retention windows: 30 days for raw inputs is acceptable as a starting point; can you confirm whether Redwood supports a soft-delete window (30 days) followed by permanent deletion? Also need assurance that model cache/kv-store entries with derived representations will be retained only in hashed form for 1 year.

3) Audit logs: we need per-request logs that show who accessed the request, what columns were redacted, and a hash pointer to the deleted payload. Is there an existing template for the audit trail format?

4) Legal: our Legal Ops asked whether Redwood supports time-limited access for auditors (i.e., generate temporary read-only access to a limited log set).

We'll collate the schema and a short redline from Legal Ops by EOD Friday. If you can provide the audit log template and confirm deletion semantics, we can commit to the proposed 2026-12-10 target pending procurement timelines.

—Emma
Emma Foster
Head of Product, Healthlytics
emma.foster@healthlytics.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP — data handling milestones & next steps (technical details)

Emma — thanks for the questions; I'm copying a brief technical note and a proposed set of defaults that we can bake into the MAP. Happy to run the 30-min deep-dive (Friday afternoon or early next week).

Technical clarifications / Redwood defaults:
- Soft-delete + permanent purge: Redwood supports a configurable soft-delete window. Default behavior: soft-delete (marked, inaccessible via API) for N days (configurable, recommended 30), then permanent purge that removes underlying object and clears cache references. We can implement WORM retention on request but that requires additional contract language.
- Model cache retention: KV cache entries are stored in encrypted form. We can apply one-way hashing to derived vectors and store only hashes for any record flagged as PHI; retention configurable up to 365 days.
- Audit trail schema (we'll attach a sample JSON schema in the MAP): timestamp, request_id, user_id, action, redaction_mask (list of fields redacted), payload_hash, keystore_reference, access_grant_id. This meets the per-request audit needs you described.
- Time-limited auditor access: supported via short-lived signed URLs and role-based access. We can provision temporary read-only access scoped to a specific log prefix and time range; logs remain immutable for the window you specify.

Proposed MAP milestone table (short):
- M1: PHI field inventory — due 2026-11-12 — Owner: Healthlytics (schema + example payload)
- M2: Retention policy decision — due 2026-11-19 — Owner: Healthlytics legal + Redwood compliance (Redwood to propose config)
- M3: Audit trail format sign-off & sample delivery — due 2026-11-23 — Owner: Redwood (deliver schema + small sample logs)
- M4: Technical deep-dive & keystore selection — due 2026-11-30 — Owner: Redwood infra + Healthlytics security
- M5: Procurement & SOW sign-off — target 2026-12-10 — Owner: Healthlytics procurement + Redwood sales

I'll upload the audit schema to the MAP doc and attach a short SOC2 excerpt. If these dates fit your procurement rhythm we'll mark them as milestones and proceed.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP — data handling milestones & next steps

Emma / Jared — thanks for the quick turnaround. I'm uploading an updated MAP (link below) with the milestone table Laura proposed plus an appended audit-schema example. The MAP includes the following changes per your ask:
- Explicit redaction rules for SSNs (auto-redact) and patient IDs (tokenize + store hashed)
- Soft-delete window set to 30 days by default; permanent purge after that unless WORM is requested
- Audit trail example included (timestamp + payload_hash + redaction_mask + access_grant_id)

Please review the doc and leave comments inline. If Legal Ops has redlines, send them to legal@redwood.ai and we'll triage.

MAP link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcd-MAP-Healthlytics (edited v0.91)
DocuSign SOW preview (read-only): https://redwood.docusign.com/H-2026-HLT-447-preview
HubSpot: HS-112358

Proposed target close: 2026-12-10 — will mark milestones in the MAP once we get your schema and Legal redline.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
